title: Luistro: Sara Duterte trial ‘bloodbath’ real, but it’s on defense’s side

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The “bloodbath” that Vice President Sara Duterte imagined would happen in her impeachment trial came true, but it was not in the way she would have wanted, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said on Friday. Luistro, lead public prosecutor for the impeachment, said in a press briefing that the bloodbath happened instead within Duterte’s camp, or the defense panel, as their witnesses’ testimony favored the prosecution. “May bloodbath nga (There is a bloodbath), but the bloodbath is happening in the defense and not in the prosecution,” Luistro said after being asked about Duterte’s previous statements.
